title: Learn Python
tagline: Real Python, right in your browser. Build games and tools from the very first lesson.

lessons.title: Hello, Python
lessons.blurb: Run your first program and learn what print does.

lessons.title: Variables and numbers
lessons.blurb: Store things, do math, and name them well.

lessons.title: Strings
lessons.blurb: Text: joining it, measuring it, and f-strings.

lessons.title: Talking to the user
lessons.blurb: input(), converting text to numbers, and your first real tool.

lessons.title: Making decisions
lessons.blurb: if, elif, else, comparisons, and True/False.

lessons.title: Repeating with for
lessons.blurb: Loops, range(), and counting things up.

lessons.title: Repeating with while
lessons.blurb: Loop until something happens. Build a guessing game.

lessons.title: Lists
lessons.blurb: Collections of things: add, remove, sort, loop.

lessons.title: Functions
lessons.blurb: Name a chunk of code and reuse it.

lessons.title: Functions, level 2
lessons.blurb: Return values, defaults, scope, and testing your functions.

lessons.title: Dictionaries
lessons.blurb: Look things up by name instead of by position.

lessons.title: Randomness and modules
lessons.blurb: import random, math, and making games unpredictable.

lessons.title: Errors and debugging
lessons.blurb: Read tracebacks like a pro and handle problems with try/except.

lessons.title: Strings, level 2
lessons.blurb: Slicing, splitting, joining, and a word game.

lessons.title: Nested data
lessons.blurb: Lists of dictionaries, sorting, and a mini database.

lessons.title: Classes and objects
lessons.blurb: Make your own types of things, with their own data and actions.

lessons.title: Saving data
lessons.blurb: Read and write files, and store game saves as JSON.

lessons.title: Build a text adventure
lessons.blurb: Put everything together into a game you design.
